official_title: ACORD 125 (Commercial Insurance Application) & ACORD 126 (CGL Section) + SOV Property Schedule
issuer: ACORD Corporation (bring your agency's own licensed ACORD 125/126/140 PDFs)

pdf_architecture.notes: ACORD 125 (4 pages) and ACORD 126 (4 pages) carry 150-300+ dense boxes, checkboxes, and location/hazard tables. Synchronized column headers let one AMS/SOV CSV populate 125, 126, and 140 together.

columns.format_notes: Shared across ACORD 125, 126, and 140 headers so multi-PDF packets stay synchronized.
